This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.24-dev** since the previous stable (v2.23). It fixes a missing option in the New Program modal.

## Fixed: New Program modal was missing the third deployment mode

When creating a new **Tiered program** (Admin → Program Data → New Program), the **Deployment requirement handling** dropdown only offered two of the three supported modes — **Flat** and **Per achieved specialisation**. The third mode, **Per tier, per achieved specialisation**, was missing from the creation modal, so you couldn't pick it up front (you'd have had to create the program and then switch it on the program's own page).

- The New Program modal's **Deployment requirement handling** dropdown now lists all **three** deployment modes, matching the selector on the program's detail page. You can choose **Per tier, per achieved specialisation** directly when creating a tiered program.

## Notes

- UI-only change — no database migration, and the created program's deployment mode is stored and applied exactly as before.

No action needed after updating.
